description: Election Commission - Notify that D. B. H. H. Mudiyanselage, elected as a member of the North Western Province Provincial Council (from Kurunegala District)
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the North Western Province Provincial Council due to a member's death. It details the electoral process under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the nomination of a replacement candidate by a political party and the formal declaration of the new member by the Election Commission. This content falls squarely within electoral processes and matters, which is the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
